title: Zabbix: Add test captures
description:
- Zabbix 3.0 (for some legacy connections)
- Zabbix 7.0 agent 2 with TLS and embedded keys
- Zabbix 7.0 agent redirection with proxy load balancing
- Zabbix 7.0 active and passive proxies, with ProxyDataFrequency=5

notes.body:
added 19 commits
  • 489eee3f...847dfcd0 - 18 commits from branch wireshark:master
  • 3fd61b9d - Zabbix: Add test captures
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/20717/diffs?diff_id=1443969270&start_sha=489eee3fd9f86bd99c99494d0462e1155753f990)

A somewhat minor point, but the `zabbix30-agents.pcapng.gz` has incorrect TCP checksums. Validating TCP checksums are off by default, but if someone runs the tests with a profile that has TCP validation on, then the test will fail. (Also for that matter if reassembly is off.) Some of the tests change various preference options; we probably want to run the tests using the global Default profile as a base.
